claims.claim: Our machines are pre-certified to work at the peak of their performance landmarks
claims.evidence: No certification document, label, or power-on/performance test shown in the photo; this is a marketing statement from the seller, not something the witness could see.

claims.claim: ...and they come with... (incomplete claim about included accessories/warranty)
claims.evidence: Statement is cut off; no accessories, box, or paperwork are visible in the photo to confirm what is included.

risks.risk: Unit may not power on or pump water (motor/pump failure)
risks.proof: Video clip of unit plugged in, running, and spraying water under pressure

risks.risk: Missing spray gun, lance, or hose (sold as bare unit)
risks.proof: Photo showing full accessory set (gun, lance, hose, nozzles) laid out next to the unit
risks.if_unproven: priced as bare unit without accessories

risks.risk: No visible brand/model label, so true make/model and genuine vs. generic/clone status unknown
risks.proof: Close-up photo of the rating label/sticker showing brand, model, voltage, and wattage

risks.risk: Voltage/plug type may not match Nigerian 220-240V standard or cable may be damaged
risks.proof: Photo of plug type and cable condition, plus label showing voltage rating
risks.if_unproven: priced assuming possible incompatibility or cable damage

risks.risk: Hidden housing cracks, leaks, or internal wear not visible from this angle
risks.proof: Photos from multiple angles including underside and water inlet/outlet, plus a short running clip showing no leaks
risks.if_unproven: priced assuming possible leak or housing damage

risks.risk: Unknown age/usage history affecting pump lifespan
risks.proof: Any purchase receipt, warranty card, or seller statement with verifiable date

proof_requests: Video of the washer powered on, pump running, and spraying water with visible pressure
Close-up photo of the rating/label sticker showing brand, model, wattage, and voltage
Photo of the plug and full length of the power cord to check condition
Photo showing all included accessories (gun, lance, hose, nozzles) laid out together
Any receipt, warranty card, or box to help verify age and authenticity
response.reason: The witness confirms this is a pressure washer by type, so it can be priced at worst case (generic/unbranded, untested, possibly missing accessories) pending the seller's unverifiable marketing claims being substantiated.
